findings.issue: Hiphil participle מַעֲלַת governs the noun גֵּרָה. Juxtaposed “levantadora rumia” can be read with “rumia” as a finite verb, which replaces the cud-noun and leaves the participle without its object.
פַרְסָה is the singular thing divided by the 3fs verb. SVO “pezuña no la partió” can make the hoof the subject, and “la” doubles that noun as a clitic.

notes: Liebre, both ella, singular pezuña, negation, impura, and a ustedes for the 2pl suffix match the tokens.
